headlines.text: It was 2021 when the inaugural Impact World Title was crowned as Christian Cage vs. Kenny Omega went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 8.21 ? a genuinely great match. The first-ever match on AEW's brand-new Friday night show ? a shocking, near-five-star title change that saw the previously undefeated Cage dethrone Omega for the Impact World Championship, a genuine surprise that set up a bigger rematch just weeks later at All Out.
Back on this day in 2025, Alexander & Fletcher made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.43 ? a good, competitive contest.
It was 2021 when Britt Baker vs. Red Velvet put the AEW Women's World Title on the line, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.40. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, it marked the first-ever meeting between Jon Moxley and Kevin Knight, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.55.

It was 2025 when Rush chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a real marker of consistency, facing The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush), topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 5.78 in a chaotic six-man affair.
